title: Red Allen, Greeley Walton and Russell Smith in the band
summary: Red Allen arrives long after Mosley; Russell Smith plays first trumpet.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: I remember Greeley (phonetic spelling) said he got fired, he was one of the first guys to get fired out of that band; that was during the time that you were there.
Yeah, Greeley was there. Red Allen was there a long time after I left. He wasn't there when I first got there.
No, no, when you first got there, it was Gus Aiken and Ham.
Yeah, but then you know who got in there later? The guy that used to be with Fletcher Henderson, Pop.
Yeah, Russell Smith was playing first trumpet.
Are you sure; in Louie's band?
You're probably right; I didn't know.
Red Allen was in there; of course he wasn't in there when I first went in, but he was there a long time.
He was in the Blue Rhythm band then.
He was there a long, long time after I got in the band and then we stayed there a long time and we had a few--
You got to be friends later on?
Oh, we got to be real friends, yeah.
everybody said Red was a terrible guy in those days.
He was a terror is right. He'd get up and take a solo--I'll never forget that--we were at the Nixon Grand and (inaudible) I fell off the bandstand.
